question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb85b32e41d5c865ee546e91efb372f997343ebd8914c386aa1fe45787b141db.png]
solution:
The image that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is as shown below :

 
• The arrow which is attached with circle moves one step in anti-clockwise from figure to figure.
 
• The rhombus with line attached to circle is added and moves one step in anti-clockwise from figure to figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89eabc8f154ecf72c51ea875bf33df671e12ba1f210b16c820fb3d7770b32311.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
